# Design System Instructions

Stand: 2026-06-17  
Status: Active

Active design source:

```text
Life OS – Linear Calm Dark Command Center
Dashboard Overhaul V5 – Subtle Color Identity Polish
```

Rules:

- P0: Today Agenda and Daily Control.
- No neon gradients.
- No glass overload.
- No chart flood.
- No generic AI-slop UI.
- Color is semantic and text-supported.

- Read `docs/design/dashboard-v5.md` before dashboard work.
